SOTHIS-PURIFY.title: Purify
SOTHIS-PURIFY.description: If used on an ally, gain block. If used on an enemy, deal damage.
SOTHIS-CORRUPT.title: Corrupt
SOTHIS-CORRUPT.description: If used on an enemy, heal the enemy. If used on an ally, deal damage.
SOTHIS-RELIEF.title: Relief
SOTHIS-RELIEF.description: Allies with [gold]Relief[/gold] gain block at the end of their turn. Enemies with [gold]Relief[/gold] take damage at the end of their turn. Decrease Relief by 1 every turn.
